lines: In 1891, Howard Carter arrived in Egypt, aged seventeen.
In eighteen ninety-one, Howard Carter arrived in Egypt, aged seventeen.
He was not yet an archaeologist, but an artist,
hired to copy the paintings on tomb walls.
He believed the valley still hid a lost royal tomb,
the tomb of the boy pharaoh Tutankhamun.
Funded by Lord Carnarvon, he dug for years and found little.
In 1922, Carnarvon wanted to give up,
